6h6l:
Students who successfully complete the Pre-Master’s in Business, Law and Social Sciences will be qualified for entry to a postgraduate degree at the University of Brighton. Each course length is determined mainly by their English language level (UKVI IELTS score or accepted equivalent).

All students take a set of common or similar modules to gain key skills for university. If the course is longer than 2 terms, they will take extra modules focusing on one or more of English language, academic skills and basic subject knowledge.
